cover.title: Why Is City Rent So High?
cover.label: NYC

lines.text: In September 2026, Manhattan's median rent needed a salary over $215,000.
lines.say: Manhattan's September rent needed a salary over two hundred fifteen thousand dollars.

lines.text: That's the 30% rule on Corcoran's September 2026 median of $5,395 a month: x 12, then ÷ 0.30 = $215,800.
lines.say: That's the thirty percent rule on Corcoran's September twenty twenty-six median of five thousand three hundred ninety-five a month.

lines.text: Nationally, Census says median asking rent rose from $1,008 in mid-2019 to $1,531 in mid-2026.
lines.say: Nationally, Census says median asking rent rose from one thousand eight dollars in mid twenty nineteen to fifteen thirty-one dollars by mid twenty twenty-six.

lines.text: Why? Freddie Mac estimated the US was 3.7 million homes short as of Q3 2024.
lines.say: Why? Freddie Mac estimated the US was three point seven million homes short in twenty twenty-four.

lines.text: Big cities have the jobs, but land is scarce, zoning caps building, and loans cost more.
lines.say: Big cities have the jobs, but land is scarce, zoning caps building, and loans cost more.

lines.text: Builder groups NAHB and NMHC said in 2022 that regulation was 40.6% of apartment development costs.
lines.say: Builder groups said in twenty twenty-two that regulation was forty point six percent of apartment development costs.

lines.text: In 2024, a record 22.7 million renter households paid over 30% of income on housing (Harvard JCHS).
lines.say: And in twenty twenty-four, a record twenty-two point seven million renter households paid over thirty percent of income on housing.

lines.text: That's about half of all US renters (49%).
lines.say: That's about half of all US renters.

post.title: Why Manhattan rent needed a $215,800 salary
post.ig:
By the 30% rule, Corcoran's September 2026 Manhattan median rent needed a $215,800 salary.

Corcoran's Manhattan median rent hit a record $5,395 a month in September 2026.
Nationally, Census median asking rent rose from $1,008 (Q2 2019) to $1,531 (Q2 2026).
Freddie Mac estimated a 3.7 million home shortfall as of Q3 2024.
In 2024, a record 22.7 million renter households (49%) paid over 30% of income on housing.

Sources: Corcoran (Sept 2026), Census Housing Vacancy Survey, Freddie Mac via CRS, NAHB/NMHC (2022), Harvard JCHS (2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
